newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH MINISTRY SETS OUT M&A MONITOR PLANS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH MINISTRY SETS OUT M&A MONITOR PLANS.

text.p: A Finnish trade and industry ministry working group on Thursday proposed to start monitoring corporate acquisitions by including them in the competition limitations act.

"The monitoring would affect corporate acquisitions in which all parties have combined net sales of over two billion markka and at least two parties have net sales over 200 million markka," the ministry said in a statement.
The competition authority could forbid a deal which would result in the creation or strengthening of a dominanant market position and significantly impede competition, it said.

Minister of Trade and Industry Antti Kalliomaki told a news conference that the proposal would be circulated for comments this spring and a proposal would be in parliament "hopefully first thing in the autumn".
He said the target was that new rules would be in force at the beginning of next year.
